checks.name: Every core game has a local module
Every current library entry has HTML and expected game implementation
Signed-run route and anti-cheat implementation exist
Browser, Android and forged-score test harnesses present
All 16 configured core games define five milestones
All achievement cosmetic rewards resolve to actual IDs
Server-side achievement evaluation source present
Server quest objectives and tiers defined
Client quest reward metadata is rejected
Quest progression regression harness present
Avatar server, editor and 3D renderer sources present
Ownership restrictions and negative API tests present
Avatar SVG fallback present
Procedural catalog and rarity model defined
Economy and payment regression harnesses present
Prestige originality uniqueness database constraint
Achievement reward cosmetics exist
Public game catalog declares skill-only tie-breaking
Server-derived metrics and equal-seed playoff source present
Giveaway and tie-break test harnesses present

requiredHumanGates: Fresh desktop and real Android device playthrough for every game
Record controls, pause/resume, restart, scoring, score submission and invalid/forged-score rejection
Capture title, active gameplay and game-over UI screenshots for every game
Record physical-device P50/P95 frame time and sustained frame drops; do not treat headless GPU results as device proof
Review actual visual identity and near-duplicate mechanics/art; automate detection is triage, not final duplicate verdict
Review every avatar slot, combination, clipping, scale, pose, animation, fallback, mobile responsiveness and save/load path
Audit shop rotation, item preview, owned/equipped states, purchase atomicity, currency deductions, generated-ID stability, one-of-one prestige uniqueness and cosmetics-only fairness
Verify every asset license and source manifest before public launch
